name: int_agg
sql: SELECT count(*) c, sum(x) s FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) t(x)

name: double
sql: SELECT 0.1::DOUBLE+0.2::DOUBLE AS f, 1e308*10 AS inf, sqrt(-1) AS nan

name: timestamp_tz
sql: SET TimeZone='UTC'; SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-10-17 12:00:00' AS ts, TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-17 12:00:00+08' AS tstz

name: date
sql: SELECT DATE '2026-10-17' AS d, DATE '1969-12-31' AS old

name: null_order
sql: SELECT x FROM (VALUES (1),(NULL),(2)) t(x) ORDER BY x NULLS LAST

name: varchar_sort
sql: SELECT s FROM (VALUES ('b'),('A'),('a'),('中'),('B')) t(s) ORDER BY s

name: cn_sort
sql: SELECT s FROM (VALUES ('上海'),('北京'),('广州')) t(s) ORDER BY s

name: no_order_agg
sql: SELECT x, count(*) FROM (VALUES (3),(1),(2),(1)) t(x) GROUP BY x

name: div_zero
sql: SELECT 1/0 AS dz, 1.0/0 AS dz2, 0/0 AS dz3

name: unbound
sql: SELECT 5000000000*5000000000 AS overflow

name: unicode
sql: SELECT '中文' AS cn, 'emoji 😀' AS em, length('中文') AS len

name: bool_null
sql: SELECT true AS t, NULL::BOOLEAN AS n

name: interval
sql: SELECT INTERVAL 1 DAY AS i, DATE '2026-01-01' + INTERVAL 30 DAY AS d

name: struct_list
sql: SELECT {'a':1,'b':'x'} AS s, [1,2,3] AS l

name: json_variant
sql: SELECT '{"k":1}'::JSON AS j

name: grouping_sets
sql: SELECT a,b,count(*) FROM (VALUES (1,'x'),(1,'y'),(2,'x')) t(a,b) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a),(b))

name: window
sql: SELECT x, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x) rn FROM (VALUES (2),(1),(3)) t(x)

name: float_sum
sql: SELECT sum(v) s FROM (VALUES (0.1),(0.2),(0.3)) t(v)
